//: Falling asleep and waking (D-930): the engine decides none of it. A mind that takes up the bundled `sleep` goal falls asleep (the trait `asleep`); one that takes up any other goal gets up; a sleeper that hears anything wakes, since a sleeper's hearing takes in only a sound loud at its ear (`human_hearing`'s threshold while `asleep`), and lies awake a minute (the trait `woken`) before it drops off again. A mod switches these off with the setting `core:sleep`.
doc: Falling asleep with the `sleep` goal, getting up with any other, and waking at a sound loud enough to be heard asleep. On unless the setting `core:sleep` is false.
A mind that takes up the `sleep` goal falls asleep, unless it was woken in the last minute.
A sleeper whose mind takes up anything but sleep is awake.
A sleeper that hears something wakes: asleep, only a sound loud at its ear is heard at all. It lies awake for a minute (the trait `woken`), seeing and hearing as ever.
A minute after waking, one whose mind still holds the `sleep` goal drops off again.
